messages.author: Patrick
messages.content: Wondering how folks feel about ripping out the multi-harness profile split so we don't require a separate profiles/openclaw.yml file.

messages.author: Mitchell
messages.content: Makes sense for now — ship native first, cross-compatibility later.

messages.author: Patrick
messages.content: Okay I did forget that part of the intention behind profiles/openclaw.yml was keeping ugly tool/sandbox YAML out of CLAW.md so CLAW.md stays human-readable.

messages.author: Holger
messages.content: Heads-up in case it saves someone time: ClawHub CLI 0.25.1 rejects an empty automations: [] key in CLAW.md, so omit the key when you have no schedules.

messages.author: Alex
messages.content: Has anyone tried the new handoff-coordinator template with clawhandoff for two-stage PR gating yet?
